items.subject: orders->payments
items.title: The orders feature changed code of payments
items.observation: 2 changed code files belong to context 'payments' (owner: Payments domain owner); the feature's home context is 'orders'.
items.suggestion: 2 files of payments changed by this orders feature under the customer-supplier relation: plan the change as a payments backlog item owned by Payments domain owner, or record a partnership / shared kernel if the two contexts evolve together.

items.subject: orders:undeclared
items.title: The deployment unit of orders is not declared
items.observation: Context 'orders' declares no deployable in domain map 1.4.0; this feature changed code in the unit(s) '.'.
items.suggestion: Declare the deployment unit(s) of orders in the domain map (contexts.orders.deployable, deployables.<name>), so the next feature can tell a new service from an existing one.

items.subject: orders:shipment
items.title: 'Shipment' is not a term of orders
items.observation: The data model or a contract uses 'Shipment', which is not in the glossary, the owned entities or the synonyms of 'orders' (or of a related context) in domain map 1.4.0.
items.suggestion: Add Shipment to the glossary of orders (or as a synonym of an existing term) in the next domain map version, or rename it in the data model and contracts.

items.subject: customers:no-code
items.title: Context customers declares no code paths
items.observation: Context 'customers' has no code paths in domain map 1.4.0, so A4.4 cannot attribute its files (it declares the modules com.acme.customers).
items.suggestion: Declare the code paths of customers (contexts.customers.code) so the context-boundary fitness function covers it.
